requirements.statement: Every chunk verdict must come from an independent gate re-running a sealed proof in a clean copy; worker narration, a coordinator log line, or a checkbox is never proof.

release requires one live successful SHIP run and a separate controlled live truthful-failure run, with different run IDs and independently verified capsules.
`neo cleanup (RUN_ID|--all-eligible) --dry-run` writes `cleanup_plan.v1`; `neo cleanup --apply --plan-sha256 SHA` applies only that plan. There is no force flag.
